indicators.name: Annual net earnings
indicators.description: Annual net earnings in euro for a single person without children earning 100% of the average earning. Net earnings are calculated from gross earnings using the tax and employee social contribution rules for this illustrative case.
indicators.source_notes: This is an illustrative tax-model case, not the median wage or an observed household income. The compiler changed from OECD to JRC (EUROMOD) in 2024; source flag b marks this break, so changes across 2023–2024 are not directly comparable.

indicators.name: Consumer price inflation (HICP)
indicators.description: Monthly HICP annual rate of change, in percent, for the total consumer basket under ECOICOP version 2. Each month is compared with the same month one year earlier.
indicators.dataset_name: Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data (prc_hicp_minr).
indicators.source_notes: Percentage change from the same month one year earlier, not month-on-month inflation or an annual-average rate. ECOICOP version 2, total consumer basket; household experiences differ.

indicators.name: Consumer price index (HICP)
indicators.description: Monthly Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices for the total consumer basket, using ECOICOP version 2 and the reference period 2025=100.
indicators.dataset_name: Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data (prc_hicp_minr).
indicators.source_notes: ECOICOP version 2, total consumer basket; 2025=100. This measures price changes, not euro costs or a personal budget. Published historical observations use the current classification.

indicators.name: House price index
indicators.description: Changes in residential property prices paid by households, covering new and existing dwellings. This index is not an asking price, a price per square metre, or a measure of the cost of an individual home.
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, House price index - quarterly data (prc_hpi_q).
indicators.source_notes: Index levels compare each country with its own base year. A higher index does not mean homes cost more in that country. This series covers total residential property.

indicators.name: Household consumption expenditure
indicators.description: Domestic-territory household final consumption expenditure in national accounts, at current prices in million euro.
indicators.dataset_name: Household final consumption expenditure by purpose (COICOP 2018)
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Household final consumption expenditure by purpose (COICOP 2018) (nama_10_cp18).
indicators.source_notes: This aggregate includes resident and non-resident households' spending on the domestic territory and excludes residents' spending abroad. It is not an individual household's or per-person spending. Country totals depend on population and prices. Use the separately published chain-linked volume index to study real expenditure changes.

indicators.name: Household consumption volume
indicators.description: Official chain-linked volume index of domestic-territory household final consumption expenditure, 2020=100.
indicators.dataset_name: Household final consumption expenditure by purpose (COICOP 2018)
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Household final consumption expenditure by purpose (COICOP 2018) (nama_10_cp18).
indicators.source_notes: This domestic-territory national-accounts volume measure removes price effects using its own national-accounts methods. It is not calculated by dividing nominal expenditure by HICP and does not describe a particular household's purchasing power or spending.

indicators.name: Household consumption price level
indicators.description: Price level index for household final consumption expenditure, with EU27 (2020 composition)=100.
indicators.dataset_name: Purchasing power parities, price level indices, nominal and real expenditures by analytical categories - based on COICOP 2018
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Purchasing power parities, price level indices, nominal and real expenditures by analytical categories - based on COICOP 2018 (prc_ppp_ind_1).
indicators.source_notes: A cross-country price-level comparison based on purchasing power parities. The EU reference equals 100 in each year; this is not a consumer-price inflation index, euro amount, or a personal cost-of-living estimate. COICOP 2018 household final consumption.

indicators.name: Housing cost overburden
indicators.description: Percentage of the population living in households where total housing costs exceed 40% of disposable household income; both amounts are net of housing allowances.
indicators.dataset_name: Housing cost overburden rate by age, sex and poverty status
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Housing cost overburden rate by age, sex and poverty status (ilc_lvho07a).
indicators.source_notes: EU-SILC total population across all ages, sexes and poverty statuses, living in private households. This is the share of people facing overburden, not the average share of income spent on housing. Costs include utilities and other recurring housing expenses. The survey-year label is retained; income generally refers to the preceding year.

indicators.name: Median equivalised disposable income
indicators.description: Annual median equivalised disposable income in euro, covering all ages and both sexes. Household disposable income is adjusted for household size and composition and assigned to each member.
indicators.dataset_name: Mean and median income by age and sex
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Mean and median income by age and sex (ilc_di03).
indicators.source_notes: EU-SILC periods label the survey year; income refers to the previous calendar year. For example, survey 2025 measures income in 2024. This equivalised, person-based median is not an actual household's income, a wage, or a monthly budget. Values are nominal annual euro.

indicators.name: Cost of borrowing for house purchase
indicators.description: ECB harmonised cost-of-borrowing indicator for new house-purchase loans to households and non-profit institutions serving households, denominated in euro; percent per annum.

status_labels.L: Missing value; data exist but were not collected

indicators.dataset_name: Cost of borrowing for households for house purchase
indicators.attribution: Source: ECB, Cost of borrowing for households for house purchase (MIR).
indicators.source_notes: A national new-business benchmark, calculated with moving-average volume weights. Annualised agreed rate (AAR) / narrowly defined effective rate (NDER); it is not necessarily APRC, a bank offer, or a personalised mortgage rate. ECB MIR keys are M.<country>.B.A2C.AM.R.A.2250.EUR.N.

indicators.name: Actual rent price index (HICP)
indicators.description: Monthly HICP index for actual rental payments made for housing (CP041), using ECOICOP version 2 and the reference period 2025=100.
indicators.dataset_name: Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data
indicators.attribution: Source: Eurostat, Harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) - ECOICOP ver.2 - indices and rates of change, monthly data (prc_hicp_minr).
indicators.source_notes: This index measures changes in actual rental payments for housing in the HICP consumer basket. It is not a new-listing rent, an average monthly rent in euro, a city-level estimate, or imputed rent for owner-occupied homes.
